description: The Aramean kingdom centered on Damascus, a recurring military rival of Israel and Judah throughout the monarchy period. David subdued Aramean forces allied against him (2 Samuel 8:5-6; 10), and later kings like Ben-hadad and Hazael repeatedly warred with Israel — Naaman, an Aramean army commander healed of leprosy through Elisha, being a notable exception to the hostility (2 Kings 5).
